#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
  int n; cin >> n;
  vector<int> ts(n);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    cin >> ts[i];
  }
  int T; cin >> T;

  sort(ts.begin(), ts.end());
  int count = 1;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    for (int j = i+1; j < n; j++) {
      if (ts[j] - ts[i] > T) {
	break;
      }
      count = max(count, j-i+1);
    }
  }
  cout << count << endl;
  return 0;
}
